mapper.select: SELECT id, channel_id, user_id, can_read, can_write, can_manage, created_at FROM channel_permissions WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} ORDER BY created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_permissions (id, channel_id, user_id, can_read, can_write, can_manage) VALUES (#{id}, #{channelId}, #{userId}, #{canRead}, #{canWrite}, #{canManage})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM channel_permissions WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} AND user_id = #{userId}
